name: In Your Flesh
source:
Six years of isolation, rules, and whispered punishments. Now, the house opens to visitors, and Laura must decide who deserves mercy – and who deserves pain.

[From [url=https://laughtertries.itch.io/in-your-flesh]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
六年的隔离、规则和低声惩罚。现在，这座房子向游客开放，劳拉必须决定谁应该受到怜悯，谁应该受到痛苦。

[来自[url=https://laughtertries.itch.io/in-your-flesh]itch.io[/url]]
